description: Inputs: a subset of the experiment's exported 1H.latency_inputs.json (validation-partition tensors, nmrexp-02). Expected: the PpmModel forward pass of py/model.py evaluated in NumPy (float32) with the fp16-stored weights read directly from each .onnx file's initializers, independent of any ONNX runtime. 'features' is the schema-1 feature record the experiment packed into each case's tensors (py/featurize.py), so the plugin's packer can be checked against the Python packing.
